preserve_original.description: Keep content in the language the user defined it, next to the working-language copy.

context_window_tokens.description: Context window size used to compute usage percent.

background.description: Do slow capture work (harvest, transcript, commit, push) after the hook returns.

poll_minutes.description: For tools without hooks (e.g. Cowork): capture every N minutes.

backend.description: Storage implementation. New backends are added in harness/storage/.

remote.description: git backend: remote URL, or 'origin' for this repository's own remote.

branch.description: git backend: branch holding the documents.

backend.description: Storage implementation. New backends are added in harness/storage/.

max_inline_size_mb.description: Larger files are stored externally and referenced from asset.yaml.

items.description: Tool id, e.g. claude-code, chatgpt, base44, monday.

tools.description: Tools this harness is used with.

checkpoints.description: When the session summary is refreshed. A checkpoint is due when ANY enabled trigger fires.

every_user_messages.description: Every N of your messages since the last checkpoint (0 = off).

every_context_percent.description: Every time context usage grew by this many points (0 = off).

force_at_context_percent.description: One forced checkpoint when usage reaches this level (0 = off).

on_compaction.description: Save the tool's own compaction summary as a checkpoint.

auto_push.description: Push to the remote at all (at checkpoints and session end).

push_every_turn.description: Push after every turn, so nothing is lost if the machine disappears (e.g. a cloud session).

enabled.description: Capture skills, agents, instructions, memory, connections from the tool.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (matched against '<kind>:<name>', e.g. 'skill:pdf' or 'skill:*') to skip.

storage_by_profile.description: Per-profile storage, overriding `storage` (e.g. a cloud profile that cannot reach a local folder).

backend.description: Storage implementation. New backends are added in harness/storage/.

remote.description: git backend: remote URL, or 'origin' for this repository's own remote.

branch.description: git backend: branch holding the documents.

claude_ai.description: Capturing claude.ai (chats, projects, memory) from its data export.

watch_folder.description: Where downloaded exports are looked for.

file_pattern.description: File name pattern of claude.ai exports.

archive_exports.description: Keep a copy of each export file in transcript storage.

export_every_days.description: How often to request a new export (used by the export skill).

download_after_hours.description: How long after requesting an export the download task runs.
